1 September  ·  Year Four

Four Years
with Puntu

Pranju & Roshan — still the best decision I ever made

My dearest Puntu,

Four years. Somehow that is both a very long time and no time at all. Long enough that I have memorised the exact sound of your laugh; short enough that I still get nervous-happy when you hold my hand.

Being loved by you is the softest, silliest, warmest thing in my life. You turn ordinary afternoons into the ones I remember — a bad chess move, a shared plate, a walk past pink flowers, your head on my shoulder in front of a little hut.

Loving you is my favourite hobby, my full-time job, and the one thing I will never ask for a day off from. Rules of us: extra dessert is always split, the window seat is yours, and every argument ends with a hug (I don't make the rules — okay, I do).

I also owe you honesty. I have made mistakes this year — moments I was careless with something precious. I am not proud of them, but I have learned from them. I am letting all of it end with this year. From the new year onward you get the better version of me: more patient, more present, more yours.

And thank you — truly — for the precious gifts you have given me. Not just the things I can hold, but every one of them I have kept safe. I still have your gifts, all of them, because they are little pieces of you and I don't lose those.

Forever yours, Roshan

Here's to year five, Puntu — and to me finally deserving you. ♥
